interpretation: The real-resource authority candidate provenance packager is frozen and independently synthetic-tested before any measured resource run. It accepts only an exact single source job/artifact plus exact independent job/artifact chain, verifies downloaded ZIP SHA256 against GitHub API artifact digest when present, binds source result SHA to independent validation, and binds the event-chain receipt to the same source run and independent validation. Duplicate exact artifacts, ZIP digest mismatch, chain/source-run mismatch and source-result hash mismatch fail closed. The output is candidate/provenance only and cannot create a durable repository authority or authorize science.
